name: agents-handoff
description: Write and receive HANDOFF.md software-change handoffs between developers and their coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Hand a finished change to another team's agent
interface.longDescription: Turns the change you just finished into a short, structured HANDOFF.md that another developer's coding agent can act on: what changed, what they must do, and what not to build. Reads one a teammate sent you, narrowed to your repository. Local-first: nothing leaves your machine unless you pick a channel.
defaultPrompt: Write a handoff for the mobile team
Receive this handoff and plan the work
Where can I send this handoff?
